name: Hauyne Idocrase
original_name: アウイン・アイドクレーズ
source:
Star Sign: Taurus
Lapis's second oldest brother.

A researcher at the magical research lab.
No matter how you look at him he seems like a woman, but he doesn't like men. He just likes to look and act pretty.
He wont approve of his little sister's romantic partners if they aren't happy with their own looks or knowledge.
translation:
Star Sign: Taurus
Lapis's second oldest brother.

A researcher at the magical research lab.
No matter how you look at him he seems like a woman, but he doesn't like men. He just likes to look and act pretty.
He wont approve of his little sister's romantic partners if they aren't happy with their own looks or knowledge.
